anomalies.observed: On page 1 (PCB.kicad_sch), the VCC rail wire drawn across the top of U2 is tapped by vertical wires to every power pin on that edge, including the two pins the symbol labels VSS (49 and 51), together with the VDD pins (24, 50) and VDDUSB (52). The remaining VSS pins (19, 39, 47, 48) and VSSA (12) are tied to GND on the bottom edge of U2.
anomalies.expected: All VSS pins must be connected to GND and never to VCC. Because the VSS pins are internally common inside the MCU, tying pins 49/51 to VCC while pins 19/39/47/48 are on GND shorts the VCC rail directly to GND through the device. The spec treats VCC and GND as the two separate global rails (section 4, 'two global rails, VCC and GND').

anomalies.impact: Direct VCC-to-GND short through the MCU; the board will not power up and the regulator/source feeding VCC is likely to be damaged or current-limited.
